claims.evidence: The single photo is a promotional/infographic-style graphic, not a dated or contextual photo of the actual unit; no way to confirm age remotely.
Image is a static marketing graphic; no video or close-up showing resistance knob or brake pad engagement in action.
Frame and flywheel are not shown in close-up; the item sits on bare concrete against a weathered wall but no detail shot of metal joints or flywheel surface is given.
No shot of accessories (pedals, straps, bottle, display) in isolation to confirm they match an original factory set.

risks.risk: Photo may be a stock/catalog graphic rather than the actual item being sold
risks.proof: A plain, undecorated photo of the physical bike as it currently sits, including any identifying marks or serial number
risks.if_unproven: treat as unverified identity match; price as generic unbranded spin bike, worst case condition

risks.risk: Resistance mechanism / flywheel may not function smoothly
risks.proof: Short video of the flywheel spinning and resistance knob being turned while pedaling
risks.if_unproven: price as if resistance mechanism is faulty or stiff

risks.risk: Frame, flywheel, or seat post may have rust or corrosion not visible in the infographic
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, flywheel base, and seat post
risks.if_unproven: price as if surface rust/corrosion present

risks.risk: Seat, pedals, or straps may be worn or missing original parts
risks.proof: Close-up photos of seat cushion, pedal straps, and handlebar grips
risks.if_unproven: price as if parts are worn or non-original

risks.risk: Frame stability or wobble during use cannot be assessed from a static graphic
risks.proof: Short video of someone pedaling the bike at moderate resistance
risks.if_unproven: price as if frame has wobble/instability

risks.risk: No digital display or monitor is visible; functionality unknown if one exists
risks.proof: Photo or video of the display powered on, if present
risks.if_unproven: price as if no working display is included

proof_requests: A real, undecorated photo of the actual bike as it is now, including the frame and base in full
Close-up photos of the flywheel, resistance knob, and brake pad area
A short video of the bike being pedaled to show flywheel motion and resistance adjustment
Close-up photos of the seat, pedals, and straps for wear or rust
Photo of any serial number, model tag, or display panel if present
response.reason: The witness confirms the item type as a spin/exercise bike, so it can be priced at worst case given the unverified condition and age claims; the promotional-style image raises provenance concerns but does not block an initial worst-case valuation pending real photos.
